There are no diagnosed causes, so all four causes remain unknown. The repeated changing-room wording is clear, but there is insufficient evidence to establish a shared underlying driver. Likewise, “unclear” does not establish a common cause for parking and pool-timetable feedback.

Confidence is high in the locker entry count and the wording groups, but low in any shared-cause finding. Diagnosis work is needed before proposing a process change. A person should check the diagnoses, assess significance and approve any resulting action.
